ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white pixels across both lobes with sharp contrast transition to low-intensity black pixels at the central junction and trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions dominate lateral lobes. A central, high-contrast dark-grey/black trapezoidal pigment patch is located at the peduncle attachment point. Dark pigmentation forms a continuous band along the entirety of the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped median notch with a pixel-calculated angle of approximately 75 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, high-frequency serrations with low-to-medium pixel amplitude across the entire trailing edge; several deeper, irregular indentations present on the distal thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a convex leading edge trajectory and a trailing edge that sweeps inward towards the median notch, ending in acute distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Scattered small, dark, circular pixel clusters (potential barnacle scars) are visible on the high-intensity white areas of both lobes, notably near the trailing edge of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are detected; specifically, three parallel diagonal lines on the mid-left lobe and several shorter vertical/diagonal marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct linear rake mark scars on both lobes and irregular notches along the trailing edge suggestive of past physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: The central dark pigmentation patch forms a sharp, geometric 'mask' shape against the surrounding white fluke surface.
